description: Assign a mail AFTER THE FACT to a person (contact_id), a lead (lead_id) or an organisation (account_id) — e.g. a mail sent with send_email before the contact existed, or an incoming mail with assignment_state 'none'/'ambiguous'. Required: email_id (incoming/fetched mail from list_emails) OR draft_id (mail sent via send_email, from list_email_history), and exactly one of contact_id / lead_id / account_id. The mail then appears in that record's communication timeline with its ORIGINAL date; who assigned it and when is recorded (audit log, record history). Optional: also_thread=true assigns the other mails of the same conversation too (same subject without Re:/AW:/Fwd: AND the same counterpart address) — mails already assigned to someone else are left alone and listed as skipped. Needs write access to the mailbox (incoming) or visibility of the sent mail.

also_thread.description: true also assigns the other mails of the same conversation
